findings.title: UN reports Israeli airstrikes, shelling and gunfire across Gaza
findings.publisher: WAFA, citing UN Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq
findings.affected_population_or_system: Humanitarian aid delivery, partner access, fuel, winterization supplies, and medical supplies
findings.exact_supporting_passage: operational bans on certain partners, import limitations on essential goods and access denials affecting more than 64 percent of the Strip.
findings.summary: WAFA's October 14 report of the UN daily briefing describes new same-day official reporting on ongoing access denials affecting over 64% of Gaza; UN agencies obtained some fuel, medicines, protective sheeting and winter clothing on October 13, but volumes remain inadequate. This is an updated account of ongoing restrictions, not evidence they began within the watch window.
